cleaned_text:
Bureau of Archives and Records
Department of Historical Documents

Memorandum — December 14, 1938
Subject: Budget Allocation for Fiscal Year 1939

To: The Honorable J. Smith, Director
From: R. Henderson, Chief Clerk

The committee has reviewed the proposed expenditures for the preservation of archival materials. An increase of $500 is recommended for the acquisition of microfilming equipment and acid-free storage supplies.

Respectfully submitted,
R. Henderson
